title: BattleScribe Scenario Spec
description: A scenario spec, specs/scenario/{category}/{id}.yaml: one engine family's data editor and roster editor in one run, joined by explicit hand-offs over a data directory. The roster editor sees data only as of the last saveData, and only when it starts or opens a roster. Model: src/BattleScribeSpec.TestKit/Scenario/ScenarioSpecModels.cs; design: docs/adr/002-scenario-specs.md.

id.description: Must match the file name, without .yaml.

category.description: Must match the parent directory's name.

item.description: Exactly one of: a data block, a roster block, or a hand-off.

data.description: Steps in the data editor: the GameData spec vocabulary, unchanged.

roster.description: Steps in the roster editor: the roster spec vocabulary, unchanged. Needs a roster: a newRoster or openRoster first.

handoffAction.description: A hand-off between the editors (ScenarioHandoffs.All). saveData: the data editor saves its open file into the data directory. newRoster: the roster editor reads the data directory and starts an empty roster. saveRoster: the roster editor saves its roster as file. openRoster: the roster editor reads the data directory and opens the roster saved as file. reloadRoster: the roster editor, its roster still open, accepts BattleScribe's offer to reload it after saveData changed a file under it.

fileHandoffAction.description: The hand-offs that name a saved roster, and so require file (ScenarioHandoffs.TakesFile).

file.description: saveRoster, openRoster: the name the roster is saved under and opened by.
